pages.text: The Lumenwilds is reached through a player-built portal. Its frame is $(thing)Lumenbound Stone$() — $(o)never$() vanilla lodestone. Build a frame like a Nether portal (a 4-wide, 5-tall ring around a 2x3 opening), then light the inner face with a $(thing)Lumen Striker$().
The Lumen Striker lights the portal (and has durability).

Right-click the inside face of the frame with the Striker to open the portal, then step through. $(br)$(br)Stuck on ingredients? Search the Overworld for $(thing)Lumenbound Ruins$() — a broken portal site with a chest of starter parts.
